result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 task.rs confirms response-side protocol metadata carriers: CreateTaskResult._meta and GetTaskResult._meta are Option<MetaObject> and survive serde; TaskAckResult also carries _meta. DetailedTask itself has no meta, so tasks/get generation/fence metadata belongs on GetTaskResult. Combined only with prior own validated request-side transport, the stock structural bridge is server result _meta -> client echo request _meta -> server RequestContext.meta. Exact arbitrary namespaced key support in MetaObject remains unresolved and is the next bounded leaf.
source_scope: CLEAN own role-local state plus official public modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk exact release source only. No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, other-role semantics, scheduler inspection, hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud/API credit, or user execution used.
scope_guard: Conclusion is limited to modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk exact rmcp-v3.1.4 release commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056 task result wrappers and serde declarations. It does not prove arbitrary MetaObject extension-key support, intermediary preservation outside serde, authenticated-principal middleware composition, persistent create-or-get/restart redrive, atomic store semantics, or exactly-once external effects.
